title: Generate Parentheses
solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/generate-parentheses/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

22. Generate Parentheses

Given n pairs of parentheses, write a function to generate all combinations of well-formed parentheses.

Example 1:

Input: n = 3
Output: ["((()))","(()())","(())()","()(())","()()()"]

Example 2:

Input: n = 1
Output: ["()"]

Constraints:

    1 <= n <= 8
"""


class Solution:
    def generateParenthesis(self, n: int) -> List[str]:
        res = []

        def backtrack(s: List[str], left: int, right: int) -> None:
            if len(s) == 2 * n:
                res.append("".join(s))
                return
            if left < n:
                s.append("(")
                backtrack(s, left + 1, right)
                s.pop()
            if right < left:
                s.append(")")
                backtrack(s, left, right + 1)
                s.pop()

        backtrack([], 0, 0)
        return res


sol = Solution()

print(sol.generateParenthesis(3))  # ["((()))","(()())","(())()","()(())","()()()"]

assert sorted(sol.generateParenthesis(3)) == sorted(
    ["((()))", "(()())", "(())()", "()(())", "()()()"]
)
assert sorted(sol.generateParenthesis(1)) == sorted(["()"])
